library(tidyverse)

# Read in data
logged_data <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRLmgMdVP3_3FXNkUobq4ejv-SANg5xMsBokWolY0ydoKgt16sfBkFhZM8RYQMjxrAGcCicsFot9W41/pub?output=csv")

# Rename variables for easier use
latest_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(
    timestamp = Timestamp,
    result = `1. Game Results`,
    color = Color,
    ending = `How the game ended.`,
    opponent_rating = `Opponent Rating`,
    time_remaining = `My remaining time at end of game.`
  )



# Check win/loss counts
table(latest_data$result)

# Check how games ended
table(latest_data$ending)

# Opponent rating stats
mean(latest_data$opponent_rating)
min(latest_data$opponent_rating)
max(latest_data$opponent_rating)

# Bar chart: game results
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = result)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Game Results",
       x = "Result",
       y = "Count")

# Bar chart: how games ended
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = ending)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "How Games Ended",
       x = "Ending Type",
       y = "Count")

# Bar chart: color played
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = color)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Color Played",
       x = "Color",
       y = "Count")

# Code for report

# Summary value 1: win rate
win_count <- sum(latest_data$result == "Win")
total_games <- nrow(latest_data)
win_rate <- round((win_count / total_games) * 100, 1)

# Summary value 2: mean opponent rating
mean_opponent <- round(mean(latest_data$opponent_rating), 0)

# Bar chart 1: game results
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = result, fill = result)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Chess Game Results",
       x = "Result",
       y = "Number of Games") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Bar chart 2: how games ended
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = ending, fill = ending)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "How Games Ended",
       x = "Ending Type",
       y = "Number of Games") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
